query: Review https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template at e99fbaeba3b55190156ebae525ad9d481d76677e. Read backend/pyproject.toml and backend/app/api/routes/items.py. What assumptions does the list endpoint make about pagination?
response: The list endpoint assumes offset-based pagination using `skip` (offset) and `limit` (page size) query parameters with default values of 0 and 100, orders results by `created_at` descending, and returns a total count to enable client-side pagination calculations.
